description: The sender goes straight to the recommended rung, several above the answered one; when that trial fails it goes back to the answered rung until the peer answers, then no higher than the failed-trial ceiling while it lasts.
note: Link setup as dts-arq/ack-wait-expiry-retransmit: conn 1 binds SAP 5 for ARQ, its S_UNIDATA_REQUEST 'ping' to SAP 9 at 0.0.1.3 at 0 makes the CAS call (request at 75000 at drc.default_speed, WN 2 Long, EOW EMPTY to a peer of unknown edition), and at 91000 the peer's PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED makes the link (16-bit family) and records the peer Ed4 (B-0408). That D_PDU's EOW is MAX-SPEED WN 6 Long (0x8A6: interleaver 101, speed 6), recorded (interp C-1262). On D_CONNECTION_MADE the rung the link was made at, drc.default_speed, position 0, counts as the last answered (interp C-1281). A transmission goes at the recommended rung, with no climb limit (corpus 0.36.0, P7-9 round 3; before, at most one above the last answered rung), except that after a failed trial it goes no higher than the answered rung until the peer answers; a transmission of ARQ data above the answered rung is a trial, and a dts.ack_wait expiry with none of the D_PDUs of the last transmission that carried ARQ data acknowledged is a silent wait, whatever else the peer has sent (open question 16; coordinator ruling 2026-11-10, corpus 0.38.0; before, a wait with nothing heard from the peer since); a silent wait after a trial is a failed trial, which caps the peer one rung below it for tx_ceiling_initial of its transmissions to the peer, doubling on each repeat failure up to tx_ceiling_cap (design shape item 7, interp C-1281); tx_step_down_waits silent waits in a row step down one rung (plan 6.2, interp C-1282); an acknowledgement of one of those D_PDUs (or, after a transmission with no ARQ data, any answer, C-1250) ends the silence count and the step down and makes that transmission's rung the answered one when it is higher. Every data D_PDU to the peer is the first header to it in its transmission and carries SENDER-APPROACH, 0xB04 (interp C-1286); PADDING carries MAX-SEGMENT 255 (interp C-1271, C-1272). Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150; WN 2 Long 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, WN 4 Long 50 bytes and 2400 ms (test data). The 29-byte DATA-ONLY needs two blocks at WN 2 Long (EOT 20, its PADDING in block 1 EOT 10, 10350 ms) and one at WN 4 Long (EOT and the PADDING's EOT ceil(2550 / 500) = 6, 3150 ms; one PADDING, 11 bytes). Each data transmission is one D_PDU, within one block of the MAX-SPEED rung, so for latency, and with no LOW-SPEED, MAX-SPEED stands in (interp C-1284, C-1285). dts.ack_wait_ms 60000; after our own transmission, a queue that refills with nothing heard goes through LBT rule 3, 3000 ms (K-0071, K-0074); after a burst addressed only to us, rule 1 (K-0067). Contention waits are seed 0's draws, uniform(16) x 3000 ms (K-0080). drc.table (corpus-format.md 6.1): ladder WN 2 Long, WN 4 Long, WN 4 Short, WN 6 Long (positions 0 to 3); no thresholds, so this node's own MAX-SPEED and LOW-SPEED never get a value (corpus-format.md 6.2 step 6) and the mixed rotation it sends each Ed4 peer it has heard is MAX-SEGMENT 255 alone (0xAFF; no SENDER-APPROACH has come, C-0956; interp C-1271, C-1272), with no top priority; sender constants tx_step_down_waits 2, tx_ceiling_initial 2, tx_ceiling_cap 4. Fixture WN 4 Short: 25 bytes and 1200 ms a block, WN 6 Long: 100 bytes and 2400 ms (test data); the 29-byte DATA-ONLY is one block at WN 6 Long (EOT ceil(2550 / 500) = 6, then six PADDING of 11 bytes, 3150 ms) and two at WN 4 Short (EOT 6, then one PADDING in block 1 with EOT ceil(1350 / 500) = 3, 3150 ms). At 108000 'ping' (FSN 0) goes at WN 6 Long, the MAX-SPEED rung, position 3, three above the answered rung drc.default_speed, position 0: a trial (interp C-1281 as revised in corpus 0.36.0, P7-9 round 3; before, it could go only one above, WN 4 Long). Nothing is heard; at its dts.ack_wait expiry, a failed trial: the peer is capped at position 2, WN 4 Short, for tx_ceiling_initial 2 transmissions, and until the peer answers no transmission goes above the answered rung. So FSN 0 is retransmitted at WN 2 Long, keeping its size (C-0549), not at the ceiling: not a trial, and failed trials never come two in a row (C-1250 counts 16 answer waits). The ceiling counts it, one transmission left. The ACK-ONLY (RX LWE 1) answers it: WN 2 Long is the answered rung. 'pong' (FSN 1, requested at 240000) goes at WN 4 Short, the MAX-SPEED rung under the ceiling, its last transmission: a trial, answered (RX LWE 2), so the hold-off goes back to tx_ceiling_initial and WN 4 Short is the answered rung. 'last' (FSN 2, requested at 400000) goes at WN 6 Long again, the ceiling having ended: a trial. Each request after an answer cancels sis.soft_link_idle (A-0320) and restarts dts.ttd; the answer that confirms the queue's last C_PDU cancels dts.ttd and starts the idle wait (A-0321: three answer waits, 180000).
